$comment: Synthetic catalog. Every entry is opt-in per person; nothing is enabled by default. Licenses of adopted software must be re-checked at adoption.

apps.title: My day
apps.does: Today's events, chores and requests for the signed-in member.
apps.exitTest: Data is the API's own records; export as JSON.

apps.title: Picture board
apps.does: Today shown as large pictures. Tap a chore card when it is finished; tap a request card to ask a parent for something.
apps.exitTest: Remove the kiosk enrolment; nothing is stored on the display.

apps.title: Family inbox
apps.does: Ask for something and follow its status; parents decide here.
apps.exitTest: Requests export as JSON or CSV.

apps.title: Allowance
apps.does: Points earned from checked chores, payouts and balance.

apps.title: Home hub companion app
apps.does: House control on a phone for adults, over the private VPN.
apps.exitTest: Hub config is local YAML with its own backups.

apps.title: Media server client
apps.does: Watch from the household library under the member's own rating profile and schedule.

apps.title: Study timer
apps.does: Focus blocks with breaks; finished blocks can count toward a chore.
apps.exitTest: No stored data beyond completed-block counts.

apps.title: Club and project tracker
apps.does: Meetings, build sessions and a to-do list for a club or hobby project.
apps.exitTest: A list kind in the API; export as JSON.

apps.title: Sky tonight
apps.does: A curated link to a free planetarium app or site chosen by a parent.
apps.license: Depends on the app chosen; verify at adoption
apps.exitTest: A link only; no household data leaves.

apps.title: Meal planner
apps.does: Recipes and the weekly plan, feeding the grocery list.
apps.license: Self-hosted options exist; verify at adoption
apps.exitTest: Recipes export; the plan is also in the API's meal domain.

suggestions.title: Chess puzzles
suggestions.why: Daily puzzle with friends from club.
